description: This file defines the HeadersFootersRenderer class responsible for rendering headers and footers to RTF in the MigraDoc document generation library. It manages the rendering process for different header/footer types and interacts with other rendering components.

classes.name: HeadersFootersRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders headers and footers into RTF format, based on document objects and page setup configurations.

methods.name: HeadersFootersRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing with document object and renderer, casting document object to HeadersFooters.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Renders all specified headers and footers (Primary, FirstPage, EvenPage) to RTF.

methods.name: RenderHeaderFooter
methods.description: Handles the rendering of individual header/footer elements, creating a HeaderFooterRenderer and invoking its Render method.

methods.name: PageSetup (setter)
methods.description: Sets the page setup configuration for rendering headers/footers.
